notes.title: Demo version
notes.notes:
Hi guys,
I reopened Facteroids Playtest with the newest demo version of the game I am preparing for Steam next fest in February.
You will find a link to [url=https://discord.gg/MX8SXsKVRE]Discord[/url] directly in the game. Please send your feedback [url=https://discord.gg/MX8SXsKVRE]there[/url] or post it on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1626530]Steam community page[/url].

I would love to hear what you think.
Jan
